content:
priya: spotted multiple KMS-wrapped files in partner S3 (partner-backups). sample log -> kms_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-01, size=4096
matt: wrap-key-01 used by Vault transit. treat as exposure; assume decrypters could unwrap.
sam: triage plan: 1) snapshot KMS + S3 access logs, 2) revoke Vault leases for partner paths, 3) temporarily remove decrypt from partner SA, 4) copy hits to sec-bucket for forensics.
jen: enable extended audit export and long retention. propose incident-unwrap SA with time-limited decrypt for controlled analysis.
alice: partner-sync lambda was supposed to upload metadata only; they paused uploads and are investigating config change.
security-bot: incident INC-331234 created (severity: medium) - applied kms-wrap runbook.
oncall: coordinate RBAC windows, watch for Vault failures during changes.
priya: action items: priya-run lease lookup+revoke (ETA 20m); matt-draft IAM revoke PR (ETA 25m); sam-provision isolated forensic host + incident SA (ETA 30m); jen-enable audit export (ETA 45m); alice-provide object list (ETA 15m).
priya: will update after revokes and IAM change :thumbsup:
